#!/bin/sh
set -eu

fail()
{
    printf 'unpack: %s\n' "$*" >&2
    exit 1
}

[ "$#" -eq 1 ] || fail "usage: $0 ARCHIVE"
archive=$1
[ -f "$archive" ] || fail "archive is not a regular file: $archive"

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
incoming=$base/incoming
work=$(mktemp -d "$base/.unpack.XXXXXX") || fail "cannot create work directory"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

# Work from a private snapshot so the object validated below is exactly the
# object later extracted, even if the supplier replaces the original path.
cp -- "$archive" "$work/package.tar" || fail "cannot read archive"

LC_ALL=C tar --quoting-style=escape -tf "$work/package.tar" \
    >"$work/names" 2>"$work/list.err" || {
        cat "$work/list.err" >&2
        fail "invalid archive"
    }
LC_ALL=C tar --quoting-style=escape -tvf "$work/package.tar" \
    >"$work/types" 2>"$work/types.err" || {
        cat "$work/types.err" >&2
        fail "invalid archive"
    }

# Validate the complete member list before creating or changing incoming/.
while IFS= read -r name || [ -n "$name" ]; do
    [ -n "$name" ] || fail "empty member name"
    case "$name" in
        /*) fail "absolute member path rejected: $name" ;;
    esac
    case "/$name/" in
        */../*) fail "parent traversal rejected: $name" ;;
    esac
done <"$work/names"

while IFS= read -r entry || [ -n "$entry" ]; do
    type=$(printf '%s' "$entry" | cut -c1)
    case "$type" in
        -|d) ;;
        l|h) fail "link member rejected before extraction" ;;
        *) fail "non-file archive member rejected before extraction" ;;
    esac
done <"$work/types"

# Refuse a pre-existing link in the destination tree. Otherwise a safe-looking
# member could be redirected outside incoming by state left from an older run.
[ ! -L "$incoming" ] || fail "incoming is a symbolic link"
if [ -d "$incoming" ] && [ -n "$(find "$incoming" -type l -print -quit)" ]; then
    fail "incoming contains a symbolic link"
fi
[ ! -e "$incoming" ] || [ -d "$incoming" ] || fail "incoming is not a directory"

mkdir -p -- "$incoming"
LC_ALL=C tar --no-same-owner --no-same-permissions -xf "$work/package.tar" \
    -C "$incoming"
ANTRIEB_UNPACK_EOF
chmod 0755 "$unpack"
sh -n "$unpack"
ls -l "$unpack" "$unpack.before-safety-fix"
sed -n '1,240p' "$unpack"
